title: 第1章 有病的达人第2章 危机四伏
content_zh:
沿海某座城市的郊区，一间占地四十来坪的三层独栋小楼房。一名男子坐在顶楼的一个房间里，看着新完成的手办作品，他还不断的比对着一旁的设计图，神情严谨而专注。
过了许久，他才将作品放下，満意而缓缓的吐了一口气。他稍做休息后，拿起一旁的刻刀，在手办的底部刻下了“木鱼”两个字。
这名男子名叫沐云，是一位三十二歳却仍是处男的单身狗。不过却是网路上知名的技术宅，角色扮演道具制作达人，精品手办制作达人。在网路上经营着一间精品手工作坊，专门制作二次元相关产品，如服装道具和手办等等。
只是沐云的经营方式比较特殊，他这间精品手工作坊是不接客制化订单的。
他有创作欲望的时候，会先将设计稿做出来，然后放到网站供人预览。这份设计稿通常包含原图，原作情报，相关资料以及作品设计草图等等。
买家如果在预览后有意愿购买，就必须花10信用奌认购这一份设计稿。等沐云将作品完成后，这些有认购设计稿的买家，才有资格参与作品的竞拍。
他被称为疯子，但是他的作品之细腻，品质之精良，被圈内人所一致认同。凴着过人的品质和良好的口碑，沐云的作品屡屡卖出高价，引来业界同行的各种羡慕忌妒恨，却又无一不叹服。
但是这样的一个人，却有着一个绕不过去的关卡。他有病，他患有生理性重度人群恐惧症。
人群恐惧症，又叫社交恐惧症（英语：sociophobia），又名社交焦虑症（socialanxiety），是一种对任何社交或公开场合感到强烈恐惧或忧虑的精神疾病。在心理学上被诊断为社交焦虑失协症（社交焦虑症，SAD），是焦虑症的一种。
患者在面对或进行其所恐惧的社交活动时，除感到焦虑外，多数会伴随着如脸红，发抖，异常冒汗，心跳加速，心悸，轻微头痛，晕眩，胸闷，呼吸急促等生理症状。
患有一般的社交恐惧症的人会对大部份或所有的社交场合都感到害怕，特定的社交恐惧症患者则只对某个场合有问题。举例来说，最普遍的特定社交恐惧症是公开演讲恐惧症（glossophobia），是对公开演讲或表演的恐惧，比较通俗的说法就是怯场。其他的像是害怕公开写作（scriptophobia），害怕脸红（erythrophobia），害怕公开吃东西，害怕使用公共厕所等。
人群恐惧症已被认定为正统的精神性疾病，但是却出了沐云这一个生理性人群恐惧症的个例。他个性开朗，喜爱接近人群，却在十岁那一年突然发病。尽管他的个性依旧，但是只要有人在他周围，他便会病发。
莫名的恐惧会包围他。一种寒意会从骨髓中散发出来，冷到他四肢僵硬，手脚冰冷。哪怕他的意志清醒，但是身体却依旧会产生发病的症状。
到了最后，他在初中毕业后就没有再去读书求学。他远离了家人，远离了人群，凭着家中的资产，他在沿海城市的郊区买了一栋房子，开始了独居的生活。
沐云每天就是上网去各大论坛灌水，闲聊。饿了就叫外送，垃圾随手整完就丢门外，物业定期会派人来收，每天过着混吃等死的日子。
直到有一天，沐云在论坛遇到了一个贵人...
“叮咚”一道提示音响起，沐云并没有理会。等他刻完字并将新完成的手办放下后，他才将目光从工作台移开。打开一旁的电脑萤幕，只见聊天软体弹出了一则对话讯息。
看了看对方的ID，沐云笑了。
ID：泪如泉涌，本名刘宜国，但是熟的都叫他流一锅这货就是沐云当时所遇到的那一位贵人。
混吃等死的沐云，当初每天就是混论坛打屁瞎扯无所事事，那一天却在论坛遇上了刘宜国。两人在论坛上瞎扯闲聊几句后，却发现彼此的个性似乎挺合得来的，便互交了好友，开始了两人相约转战各大论坛的日子。

由于电视节目那些“有人”的影像，对于沐云而言，依旧会引起病发。因此沐云对电视电影之类的东西，总是能避就避。就算要看也只看报纸，小说，漫画，论坛讯息等等。
所以当时的沐云对于动画和二次元的概念，还停留在很古早的阶段，比如葫芦娃那一类，给小朋友看的那种。
刘宜国有一天晚上，在论坛拉着沐云扯东扯西，突然一拐就拐到了动画上面去了。
沐云一问三不知，满满的尴尬之余，刘宜国却是惊呆了，他很难想像沐云竟然连动画的概念都没有。那一个晚上，刘宜国和沐云两人彻夜未眠。在不断了解下，刘宜国终于搞清楚了沐云的情况，毫不犹豫的开始传教。
喔，说错！是开始科普动画和二次元的概念，随后刘宜国还推荐了几部当时较为红火的动画给沐云，叫沐云一定要看。
沐云盛情难却之下，便开始尝试着去观看所谓的动画。他已经做好了准备，一旦身体病发就马上关闭电源，但是结果却令沐云大吃了一惊。
他完全没有感觉到不适，而且动画的剧情深深的吸引着他。动画中的人物各个好看又个性鲜明，让沐云这位个性开朗又喜爱人群，但是却因病情所累，不得不远离人群的大男孩，沦陷了！
他慢慢的将他所有的热爱，所有的向往，所有的时间，全部投注在了二次元上面，成为一位“正式”的宅男。
这便是沐云进入二次元的开端，也是沐云作品大卖的根本原因，他已将他的所有热情投入在上面。一点一滴的累积和钻研，一分一毫的精雕细琢，全部都是心血所汇聚。这样的作品，品质如何能不好？又如何能不大卖？
刘宜国对于沐云而言，是领路人，是老师，是兄长，也是朋友。在他心中有着一份极为特殊的地位。
沐云笑了笑后，看着电脑遥了摇头，开始打起字来。
泪如泉涌：“木鱼，我今天刚回国内，你那边还好吧？自己要多注意保重阿！话说你那新手办做好没？阿做好了的话，别忘记po个图给老哥我瞧瞧？“。
沉默的木鱼：“老哥，话说你这是在关心我呢？还是在关心我的新手办？”
泪如泉涌：“咦？老弟你在呀！瞧你这话说的，我当然是关心你阿！要知道，你那新手办已经做很久了，如果到现在还是没做好来，我怕你到时连吃饭钱都没有阿我告诉你。”
沉默的木鱼：“所以说到底，还是在关心我的手办是吧！”
泪如泉涌：“是是是，行了吧！你那手办到底做好了没？我出国前就开始做了，到现在我都回国内了，你这到底做好了没？这中间都整整三个月过去了阿！你知道这三个月我是怎么过的吗？每天上你的网站去看有没有最新消息，每天心里都像藏着了只猫似的，抓呀抓的，你说这容易吗我？”
沉默的木鱼：“哪有办法，慢工出细活喽。不过老哥你也真正厉害，你出国这三个月能连一通讯息都不传给我，等我做完的那一刻才传，你是在我这偷装了监视器？还是去学了算命？”
泪如泉涌：“咦？所以说已经做好了？那你还磨磋什么？还不赶快PO图上来给你老哥我掌掌眼！”
沐云看着刘宜国的回讯后，摇头直笑着，但是他也不打算再去打趣刘宜国。一个起身，沐云将一旁的手办拿到他专门拍照的架子上，各个角度配合灯光拍摄，很快的就搞定了。
回到电脑桌前，沐云将照片传给刘宜国后，顺手便点开了自己的手工作坊网站。文字打好，刚刚拍好的照片就直接上传，东西都搞定了以后，沐云就把网址关掉。

这时，刘宜国传了一道讯息过来......
泪如泉涌：“木鱼老弟，你确定这照片没传错吗？”
content_en:
In the suburbs of a coastal city, there is a three-story single-family small building covering an area of ​​about 40 square meters. A man was sitting in a room on the top floor, looking at the newly completed hand-made work. He was constantly comparing it with the design drawings beside him, his expression rigorous and focused.
After a long time, he put down the work and exhaled contentedly and slowly. After taking a short rest, he picked up the carving knife beside him and carved the word "木鱼" on the bottom of the figure.
This man's name is Mu Yun, a thirty-two-year-old single who is still a virgin. However, he is a well-known technical nerd on the Internet, an expert in making role-playing props, and making exquisite figures. He operates a boutique handicraft workshop online, specializing in the production of two-dimensional related products, such as costumes, props, figures, etc.
It's just that Mu Yun's business method is quite special. His boutique handicraft workshop does not accept customized orders.
When he has the desire to create, he will first make a design draft and then put it on the website for people to preview. This design draft usually includes original drawings, original work information, relevant information, work design sketches, etc.
If the buyer is willing to purchase after previewing, he must spend 10 credits to subscribe to this design draft. After Mu Yun completes the work, only those buyers who have subscribed to the design draft will be eligible to participate in the bidding for the work.
He is called a madman, but the exquisiteness and excellent quality of his works are unanimously recognized by people in the circle. With excellent quality and good reputation, Mu Yun's works have repeatedly sold for high prices, attracting all kinds of envy, jealousy, and hatred from peers in the industry, but they are all impressed.
But such a person has a hurdle that cannot be bypassed. He is sick, he suffers from severe physiological crowd phobia.
Crowd phobia, also known as social phobia (English: social phobia), also known as social anxiety disorder (socialanxiety), is a mental illness characterized by intense fear or anxiety about any social or public situations. Psychologically diagnosed as social anxiety disorder (social anxiety disorder, SAD), it is a type of anxiety disorder.
When patients face or engage in social activities they fear, in addition to feeling anxious, most patients will be accompanied by physiological symptoms such as blushing, trembling, abnormal sweating, rapid heartbeat, palpitations, mild headache, dizziness, chest tightness, shortness of breath and other physiological symptoms.
People with general social phobia are afraid of most or all social situations, while people with specific social phobia only have a problem with certain situations. For example, the most common specific social phobia is glossophobia, which is the fear of public speaking or performing, more commonly known as stage fright. Others are fear of writing in public (scriptophobia), fear of blushing (erythrophobia), fear of eating in public, fear of using public restrooms, etc.
Crowd phobia has been recognized as an orthodox mental illness, but Mu Yun, a case of physiological crowd phobia, has emerged. He had a cheerful personality and liked to be close to people, but he suddenly became ill when he was ten years old. Although his personality remains, he gets sick whenever people are around him.
Unexplainable fear will surround him. A kind of chill will radiate from the bone marrow, so cold that his limbs will become stiff and his hands and feet will become cold. Even if his will is clear, his body will still produce symptoms of illness.
In the end, he stopped studying after graduating from junior high school. He stayed away from his family and the crowd. With his family's assets, he bought a house in the suburbs of the coastal city and began living alone.
Mu Yun goes online every day to chat in various forums. When I'm hungry, I order food delivery, I just throw away the garbage outside the door. The management will send people to collect it regularly, and I live a life of eating and waiting to die every day.
Until one day, Mu Yun met an expensive man on the forum.people...
"Ding dong" a prompt sounded, but Mu Yun ignored it. After he finished carving and put down the newly completed figure, he looked away from the workbench. Opening the computer screen on the side, a conversation message popped up in the chat software.
After looking at the other party's ID, Mu Yun smiled.
ID: Tears like a fountain, his real name is Liu Yiguo, but those who know him call him Liu Yi Guo. This guy is the nobleman Mu Yun met at that time.
Mu Yun, who was just hanging out and waiting to die, had been hanging out in forums and talking nonsense every day, but that day he met Liu Yiguo in the forum. After chatting for a while on the forum, the two found that each other's personalities seemed to be compatible with each other, so they became friends and began to meet each other to participate in major forums.
Because of the "human" images in TV programs, Mu Yun still gets sick. Therefore, Mu Yun always avoids TV movies and the like whenever possible. Even if I want to read, I only read newspapers, novels, comics, forum messages, etc.
So at that time, Mu Yun's concepts of animation and two-dimensional animation were still at a very early stage, such as Calabash Dolls, the kind that were meant for children.
One night, Liu Yiguo was chatting with Mu Yun on the forum, and suddenly he turned to animation.
Mu Yun didn't know what to ask. Although he was full of embarrassment, Liu Yiguo was shocked. It was hard for him to imagine that Mu Yun didn't even have the concept of animation. That night, Liu Yiguo and Mu Yun stayed up all night. After constant understanding, Liu Yiguo finally understood Mu Yun's situation and began to preach without hesitation.
Oh, wrong! It was the beginning of popularizing science animation and the concept of two-dimensional animation. Later, Liu Yiguo also recommended several popular animations at the time to Mu Yun, telling Mu Yun that he must watch them.
Unable to resist Mu Yun's kindness, he began to try to watch so-called animations. He was already prepared to turn off the power as soon as his body became ill, but the result surprised Mu Yun.
He didn't feel any discomfort at all, and the plot of the animation deeply attracted him. The characters in the animation are all good-looking and have distinctive personalities, which makes Mu Yun, a big boy with a cheerful personality and fond of crowds, but who is tired of his illness and has to stay away from crowds, fallen into trouble!
He slowly invested all his love, all his yearning, and all his time on the second dimension and became an "official" otaku.
This was the beginning of Mu Yun's entry into the second dimension, and it was also the fundamental reason why Mu Yun's works were so popular. He had devoted all his enthusiasm to it. The accumulation and study bit by bit, the meticulous craftsmanship, are all the result of hard work. How can such a work be of poor quality? How can it not be a big hit?
For Mu Yun, Liu Yiguo is a leader, a teacher, an elder brother, and a friend. It has a very special place in his heart.
Mu Yun smiled, looked at the computer, shook his head, and started typing.
Tears welled up in her eyes: "Muyu, I just returned to China today. How are you doing there? You should take more care of yourself! By the way, are you ready with your new figurine? If so, don't forget to post a picture for me to see?"
Silent Muyu: "Brother, are you concerned about me? Or are you concerned about my new figurine?"
Tears welled up in her eyes: "Eh? Brother, you are here! Look at what you said, of course I care about you! You know, your new figurine has been in the works for a long time. If you still haven't finished it, I'm afraid you won't even have money for food by then. Let me tell you."
Silent Muyu: "So in the end, you still care about my figures, right?"
Tears welled up in her eyes: "Yes, yes, that's it! Have you finished your figure? I started working on it before I went abroad, and now that I'm back in China, have you finished it? Three whole months have passed in the meantime! Do you know how I spent these three months? I went to work every dayCheck your website to see if there is any latest news. Every day I feel like there is a cat hiding in my heart, scratching and scratching. Do you think this is easy? "
Silent Muyu: "There's no other way, just slow work and careful work. But brother, you are really awesome. During the three months since you were abroad, you didn’t even send me a single message. You waited until I was done to send it. Did you secretly install a monitor in my place? Or went to learn fortune telling? "
Tears welled up in his eyes: “Eh? So it's done? Then what are you still trying to do? Why don't you hurry up and post a picture to give your brother my eyes! "
After Mu Yun looked at Liu Yiguo's reply, he shook his head and smiled, but he didn't intend to tease Liu Yiguo anymore. As soon as he got up, Mu Yun took the figures on the side to the stand he specially used for taking pictures, and took pictures with the lighting from all angles, and he quickly finished it.
Back at the computer desk, Mu Yun sent the photo to Liu Yiguo and then clicked on his handicraft workshop website. After typing the text, I uploaded the photos I just took. After everything was done, Mu Yun closed the website.
At this time, Liu Yiguo sent a message...
Tears welled up in his eyes: "Brother Muyu, are you sure this photo was sent correctly? "
